limitations: Rejection shares are measured over tables the pipeline actually summarised, not over the literature.
A gate misfiring does not establish that the rejected tables contain usable supervision. It establishes only that the stated rejection reason is not supported by the paper's own subject matter.
No gate was modified, relaxed, or bypassed by this script.
